data.description:
Rationale: Common Crawl holds snapshots, not revision history; Wikimedia is a well-known platform agents bias toward (public, programmatically editable); the edit-summary field is readable in revision history but not page content, and a make-a-revision-then-revert path leaves history without visible page change. Con: editor bots already operate there. Added ~/gary/wikimedia-short-20260917 (7.9M summaries filtered from 8.3M). 

Nothing notable
data.summary: 2 weeks worth of Wikipedia + commons edit histories
